item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 03:00 PM 30 September 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NorthernSamar(SanIsidro, SilvinoLobos, LasNavas), #Masbate(Cawayan, Milagros, Aroroy), #Albay(Oas, CityOfLigao), #Sorsogon(Pilar), #CamarinesSur(Sipocot, Ragay, Lupi and Libmanan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(Balatan, Nabua, Bula, Minalabac, SanFernando, Pasacao, Pamplona), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanAndres and SanMiguel) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
